source.label: BraDD-S1TS meta.csv (inside the Zenodo zip)
source.method: one point per Brazilian state listed in meta.csv (approximate state centres); the dataset publishes no sample coordinates

note: 25,988 Sentinel-1 time-series samples (~2.5 km) across the Legal Amazon; per-state counts: PA 11604, MT 3264, AM 2901, RO 2875, AC 2329, RR 1457, MA 1048, AP 390, TO 120. The .pt samples carry image/label/dates only; the true centre map exists only as pictures/CenterLocationMap.svg in the GitHub repo.
